scope: Local synthetic company and controlled Go services
detach: Returned the accepted task ID while the server continued

stop.result: Stopped at checkpoint with saved graph events

reconnect: A separate CLI process replayed saved events and observed the interrupted checkpoint
issue_found: Interrupted watch displayed the incident's NEW status as its completion label
fix: Show INTERRUPTED and a resume command; an interrupted job cannot be reported as successful unless a stop was requested

regression_checks.scope: Terminal unit checks and real Windows launcher invocations against a local HTTP stub; these checks do not perform live inference

limitations: One local interruption rehearsal. Does not prove recovery from every crash or network failure. Analytics intentionally remains unhealthy.
